name: Burning Ship Fractal
desc: A slow cinematic drift through the eerie Burning Ship fractal rigging — antenna masts and self-similar armadas rendered in flickering smooth-iteration flame, ice, toxic acid, posterized rainbow bands, or a monochrome engraving.

scale.doc: feature zoom into the ship rigging (higher = deeper)

hue.doc: palette base hue (warm flames ~18; drives spectral bands)

x.doc: pan center x within the fractal window

y.doc: pan center y within the fractal window
